description: Base de données DFCI sur le département des Bouches-du-Rhône is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendfci.fr. The DFCI database gathers several data sources useful for DFCI campaigns in the Bouches-du-Rhône region. It brings together several partners who publish their data on a single portal: These data cover both the DFCI equipment set up and maintained by the SDIS (tanks, fire pole, DFCI tracks and roads, manoeuvring areas, difficulties, etc.), the history ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DFCI database on the Bouches-du-Rhône department" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zones à risque naturel. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
